text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Yui. Throw me a bone here. Having tea together and all that is good,
but PLEASE tell me you didn't just let him go home after that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ユイ。
まさかお前、
その後ただ普通にお茶して
終わっただけじゃないだろうな？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry. That's exactly how it went.
He had work lined up as well,
so I didn't have a choice but to see him off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ギルドハウスで、
一緒にお茶を飲んで、
お仕事があった騎士クンをお見送りして……
おしまいだよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Figures... Listen. I hate to break it to you,
but you're gonna be friend-zoned for life at this rate. You really 
wanna be shopping for books together like fifty years from now?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりか……
そんなんだと、
何年たっても
いいお友達のままで終わっちまうぞ？
じいさんばあさんになっても本屋でデートする気か？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Err, I'd rather avoid that...
text_block_list.orig_text: そこまではさすがに……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I get that you're scared, but there's an easy solution to that.
You gotta find out how he feels about you first, so get your butt outta here and go do that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイは相手のことが分からないから、
勇気が出ないんだよ。
今すぐあいつの気持ちを、
ちゃんと確かめてこい！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Ehhhhh?!
text_block_list.orig_text: ええええっ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I actually got kicked out of my own guildhouse.
Makoto sure means business...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……結局マコトちゃんに追い出されちゃった。
わたしたちのギルドハウスなのに……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Find out how he feels about me? How am I even supposed to
do that? This is Mr. Knight we're talking about. I'm not even
sure where he'd be at this time...
text_block_list.orig_text:
気持ちを確かめろって言われても、
どうしたら……
騎士クンが街のどこかにいるといいんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
G-good afternoon. Fancy meeting you here, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン！
こ、こんにちは。
偶然だね！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Hey... You wouldn't happen to have a moment, would you?
If you do, can we move somewhere else?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あのね。
少し、お話し出来ないかな？
もし良かったら、
場所を変えてもいい？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Here should do.
Thanks for coming along.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ここならいいよね。
ついて来てくれてありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
First of all, thanks for helping me with my shopping the other day.
I learned a lot of new magic thanks to that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン、
この間は買い物に付き合ってくれてありがとう。
あの時買った本で勉強して、
色んな魔法が使えるようになったよ。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: For example...
text_block_list.orig_text: 例えばこんな魔法とか……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
How do you feel? Nice and warm? 
In simple terms, this spell both heats you up and makes 
ice-based attacks ineffective. I'd been wanting to learn it for a while.
text_block_list.orig_text:
体が温かくなったでしょう？
この魔法はね、
寒い場所や冷気の攻撃が平気になるんだよ。
前から覚えたかった魔法なんだ。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Wait a minute. What am I doing?!
This isn't the time for lectures on magic!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……何言ってるのわたし！？
魔法の説明してる場合じゃないのに！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Urgh. How am I supposed to ask him something like that?!
Help me out here, Makoto!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
どんな風に聞けばいいかわかんないよぉ～！
助けて～！　
マコトちゃーん！！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I-it's pretty nice, isn't it? It'll come in handy if
we're ever in a cold region and someone needs help.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
この魔法があれば、
もしも誰かが寒い場所で困ってたら
助けてあげられるよね……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Or I hope so, at least. I just want to be useful...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで今までよりは、
みんなの役に立てるかな……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Oh... You think?
choice_data_list: You're more important than you realize.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう……
なのかな？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Important, huh...
Really? That wasn't just my own selective hearing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
大事な人……
今のって、
聞き間違いじゃないよね……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Wow. I didn't know he felt that way about me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン、
そんな風に思ってくれてたんだ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I won't lie. It's really... fulfilling to hear him say that.
It's giving me this warm, fuzzy feeling.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……大事な人、
だって。
嬉しいな……
胸の奥まで、
温かい気持ちが広がってく……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Knight... 
I really need to know. Is there anyone he likes?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン……
好きな人、
いるのかな……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! D-did I... Did I say that out loud?! Uhh...
W-well, you see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっ！？　
い、
今の、
聞こえちゃってたの！？
そ、
それは……
えっとね……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You are an amnesiac, now that I think about it.
Did you forget what it means to like someone, too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば騎士クン、
記憶がないって……
もしかして、
好きの意味が分からないんじゃ……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Let's see here... If you like someone, then you get all sorts of
feelings when you're with them. Excitement. Happiness. That sort of stuff.
You also wish you could spend more time with them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……好きっていうのはね、
誰かと一緒にいると胸がドキドキしたり、
心がぽかぽかしたりして……
この人ともっと一緒にいたいって思う、
そんな気持ちのことだよ。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you can like someone in the same way that you like food.
But that's not how I meant it. It's a bit... deeper than that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
食べ物を食べたら、
美味しいからまた食べたいって思うのも「好き」だけど、
わたしが言ったのは……
その「好き」とは違う気持ちなの。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
For example, 
I like Hiyori and Rei a lot.
But I don't LIKE like them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……それにね、
わたしはヒヨリちゃんもレイちゃんも好きだけど……
もっと違う「好き」もあるの。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, this must sound really confusing.
I get the idea behind it myself,
but it's just really hard to explain...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんね。
あんまり上手く説明出来なくて……！
好きっていう気持ちは知ってるんだけど、
言葉にするのは難しくて……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Me?!
Err, uhh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたし！？
あの……
えっと……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Oh gosh, oh gosh!
How am I supposed to respond?! Should I just be blunt?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわわわわ……！
そんなこと言われても、
どう伝えたらいいの……！？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's a secret!
One day I'll tell you, so be patient until then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……い、
今は内緒！
……いつか必ず言うから！　
それまで待ってて！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Thanks...
text_block_list.orig_text: ありがとう……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
It might take a while, but one day I'll do it.
One day I'll find the courage to tell him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……わたしがもっと勇気を持てるようになって、
この気持ちを言葉にするまで……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: That day will come. I promise.
text_block_list.orig_text:
待っててね……
騎士クン。
